feature: Texture mipmaps + trilinear filtering (stops texture shimmer)
approach: [Graphics] Mipmaps=1: start-up hooks on DDraw_CreateTextureSurface 0x004a83d0 (replaced: same surface plus DDSD_MIPMAPCOUNT, DDSCAPS_MIPMAP|COMPLEX, single level if refused), Texture_UploadPixels 0x004a8500 (trampoline, then every smaller level filled with a 2x2 average keeping colour key 0) and Render_CreateD3DDevice 0x004a9c20 (trampoline, then TEXTUREMIN 0x12 = D3DFILTER_LINEARMIPLINEAR 6)
notes: 2026-10-16 user report: sharp texture packs shimmer while moving or turning (dock edges, the white line running along the black top edge of the blast barrier); the original shimmers too but less visibly. Cause (CONFIRMED-BINARY): every texture is one level (no mipmaps) and the device sets TEXTUREMIN to LINEAR once, so distant surfaces skip between texels of the full-size image. Ruled out first: dgVoodoo KeepFilterIfPointSampled=false, 2x supersampling (slower, no change), 512 px pack (still shimmers), blurred pack (less shimmer, looks worse), dgVoodoo autogen mipmaps (no effect while the game asks for LINEAR). First commit d79f84a5 made the mip chains but they were never sampled; abf5132e added the TEXTUREMIN switch. prove_identity 4678/4716 (VERIFIED-IDENTICAL, unchanged). User play-test 2026-10-16: shimmer gone, ""looks good now"" (VERIFIED-PLAYPATH by the user, mission 1). Mipmaps=0 = original behaviour
